abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Alvenor reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 83 | 550 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 50 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 102 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Side effects | 57 | 550 |

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 12.9 | 6.5 | 550 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 13.0 | 6.5 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 12.7 | 6.3 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 12.8 | 6.4 | 550 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
